// RED fixture for `no-untagged-personal-data` — the ISSUES-relevant slice (ISS-P01 / P-125).
// The lint MUST reject this. The issue_comment row's free-text body field (`comment_text`, a PII
// fingerprint) carries NO #[personal_data(...)] tag — so the per-subject DEK crypto-shred erase
// (architecture issue-tracker §6.1 / 03 §7) and the RoPA/data-map fan-out would NOT reach it,
// leaving an un-erasable subject (ADR-12). The author pseudonym IS tagged here, isolating the
// failure to the deliberately-untagged body field. (This is the body-field analogue of the
// deliberately-untagged worklog fixture the prompt names — the lint fingerprints by PII field NAME;
// the live worklog tag is proven green on the real schema by the workspace scan over myelin-issues.)
pub struct IssueComment {
    pub tenant: TenantId,
    pub region: Region,
    pub comment_id: u128,
    #[personal_data(
        category = Identifier,
        role = TenantContent,
        basis = Contract,
        retention = UntilContractEnd,
        erasure = Pseudonymise,
        subject_locator = "author_pseudonym",
    )]
    pub author_pseudonym: String,
    pub comment_text: Vec<u8>,
}
